subject: Literature
subcategory: Classic Novels That Changed the World
title: The Great Gatsby and the American Dream
description: Learn The Great Gatsby and the American Dream in one minute.

hook.text: When F. Scott Fitzgerald published The Great Gatsby in 1925, it was considered a commercial failure.

buildup.text: The novel told of Jay Gatsby, a mysterious millionaire chasing a lost love across Long Island's mansions.

discovery.text: Gatsby's wealth was built on crime, and the dream he chased was already dead before he reached it.

twist.text: The U.S. Army distributed the novel to soldiers in World War Two, and it became a national obsession.

climax.text: The Great Gatsby is now considered the definitive portrait of America's obsession with wealth and reinvention.

punchline.text: A flop became America's mirror sixty years later.

quiz.question: How did The Great Gatsby become famous?
options: It was an instant bestseller in 1925
The U.S. Army distributed it to soldiers in World War Two
